content_gate: collect.content_gate.gate (>= 200 chars and a filled field); every pair row must pass it
per_class_budget: median of the per-class row counts of data/router/train.jsonl (computed, not stored here)
row_order_rule: within a class, projects are ordered by sha256(seed|label|project|project_id); their rows (each in sha256(seed|label|doc_id) order) are interleaved one per project in turn

contrastive.source: labels named, by label name or by an unambiguous regional name, in each v9 definition's Is-not line; edges are made symmetric
contrastive.menu: two labels: the row's own label and one neighbour; system prompt = router.teacher_label.prompt_for(menu)
contrastive.assignment: each class's eligible rows are ordered by sha256(seed|label|doc_id); the first min(eligible, budget) rows each get one neighbour, round-robin over the class's neighbours in label-set order
contrastive.edges_governed_elsewhere: the edge between the two labels of combined_form.labels is built only by the combined-form rule
contrastive.neighbour_choice_rule: rows whose first head_chars characters name one of the class's Is-not neighbours (label name or unambiguous regional name) fill the budget first; such a row is paired with the least-used named neighbour whose edge count is below edge_cap_factor x ceil(rows / neighbours) (the same 3x-share idea as the sampler cap); otherwise, and for rows naming none, with the least-used neighbour; ties in label-set order

combined_form.source: LABEL_SET_v9 combined-form notes: certifier section blank or not signed -> application; completed and signed with a certified amount -> certificate
combined_form.owner_rule: certified amount present AND certifier signature/date present -> payment certificate; certifier block blank -> payment application
combined_form.pairing: one application-side and one certificate-side document from the same family make a pair; unmatched documents make no pair

catch_all.instrument_labels: every label in configs/router/labels.json that is not a catch-all label
catch_all.instrument_test: the label name or one of its unambiguous regional names occurs in the first head_chars characters of the text
catch_all.menu: the row's own catch-all label plus every instrument label; system prompt = router.teacher_label.prompt_for(menu)
catch_all.sibling_rule: each selected catch-all row also gets a two-label menu: its own catch-all label and the least-used sibling catch-all label; ties in label-set order
